## 🔄 How It Works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph Input["📹 YouTube Channels"]
        A1["Indie Hacker News"]
        A2["Github Awesome"]
        A3["Hyperautomation Labs"]
    end
    B["📥 yt-dlp Scan"]
    C["📝 Extract Descriptions"]
    D["🔍 Regex: github.com/owner/repo"]
    E["🌐 GitHub API → Star Count"]
    F["📄 Generate README.md"]
    G["🚀 GitHub Push"]

    Input --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D --> E
    E --> F
    F --> G
    G -.->|Daily 8:00 UTC| Input
```
